notes.title: STORY & CINEMATIC UPDATE
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Time for an update! 

I know it looks like we're going slow but once again I want to remind you that we're just 3 people and one of us is not even a developer:) so basically we're doing this project as 2 persons. 

But don't worry! It's going great. Since the beginning of 2025, I delved more into story elements and cinematics while our programmer was working on our gameplay systems which we'll share more later.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/CKt1LkgZ/gif-01.gif[/img]

Unawake is like a 3D Diablo. You fight, you gain loot, you fight again. And we have numerous mods and superb end game features to support you for years to come. You'll never be bored in Unawake. As gamers ourselves, we think we have created an ultimate game design which we can't wait to share with you in future updates.

BUT... This doesn't mean Unawake doesn't have a story. On the contrary, I can proudly say that we have an incredible story which has many twists and epic moments to make you excited as you play the game.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/GvBSH2hm/gif-05.gif[/img]

Like most successful RPG games, we buried our tutorial sections (which are very few anyway) into the beginning of the game. But what a beginning... You start the game at the peak of the ultimate battle between angels, demons and mankind. The situation is grim and humans can't trust anyone; including angels.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/904HWYJ/gif-07.gif[/img]

In the fog of this forsaken war, a figure emerges. Everyone greets him as a commander and he barely escapes from a vicious demon charge. He holds his soldiers at an ancient bridge while angels start to burn the world just to destroy the demons...

[img]https://i.ibb.co/W4kk7gpR/gif-03.gif[/img]

We learn that mankind teamed up with renegade angels who defied the One. The leader of these Fallen Angels who is called Azazel; opened the gate to Hell to arm themselves with demons. To use them against the Holy Angels which descended to fight them. But things went wrong. Azazel couldn't have predicted that the Hell Legions were too strong and they have a similar hierarchy like the Heaven.

So in a very small amount of time, things went mad. Angels were slaughtered like pigs and words got out that Azazel was captured and his son, the human king is dead; as well as his commanders... Except one.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/8Lfz06ZN/gif-02.gif[/img]

After we live the climax of the war; we travel thousands of years into the future and start the game. Our character wakes up on what looks like a tomb at the summit of a huge pyramid. There are priests and they are calling him "Unawake". But who is he? Why isn't he dead? What's so important about him? 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/60xfv5Nt/gif-04.gif[/img]

They say he's here. The infernal prison of Azazel. He quickly realizes the surreal, unreal world he's looking at. This is not Earth. But where is he? 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/PvWS2Dp3/gif-06.gif[/img]

There are so many questions but so many answers for you to find out in the epic journey of Unawake. In future updates, we'll delve more into gameplay and our new systems. 

Stay tuned and see you all later!

Ismail Kemal Ciftcioglu

[url=https://www.instagram.com/art_of_kemal/]Instagram Link[/url]
Game Director, Designer, Animator, Writer, Coffee Maker and other sort of things except programming.

notes.title: New Updates, New Video and a Happy New Year!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

I'm Kemal; the writer, designer and director of the game. I have many roles since we are a team of 3:). This was a very interesting year for us. We have managed to create and finish so many systems and we also did so many enhancements based on your feedback.

We also got some new decisions regarding our activity here. Since we are a very small team (3), we were mostly busy with developing our systems and trying to solve some very complex puzzles in creating Unawake. However, we have managed to reach a very stable life now and we'll be spending much more time in sharing what we're doing.

Starting from January, I'll be personally sharing behind the scenes videos, images and much information to understand what Unawake really is and how we're developing it. I'll also be sharing detailed information about our gameplay. What's the difference of Unawake from other action adventure or RPG titles? What are the side & end activities? How big is the game? Is the story important and how deep is the lore? Who is our character? What sort of customizations and enhancements can we make? What about loot? These and so many others will be answered with my regular updates. Oh and I'll be actively answering yours as well, either from here or social media.

Regarding social media; all of our channels including Discord will be opened anew. I'll make another update for them probably in the first week of January.

Every week, there will be updates either about the game, behind the scenes or some lore. We'll be always in touch with you.

By the way, I have uploaded a new video here which shows some of our cinematics. You can watch it in the Store's gallery. Of course, all is still under development and will be modified & enhanced in the months to come.

2025 will be a very exciting year for Unawake, so as behalf of our team, I wish you a happy, awesome new year!

Ismail Kemal

notes.title: Scream Fest has arrived – and so did a new demo
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41046689/c62290ef3199408289995bf09f63997c39e5cbe3.png[/img]

Hello Scream Queens and Kings, 

with Steam Scream Fest celebrating sinister, dark, mysterious, and downright spooky games, we can reveal to you that a new, enhanced and Halloween themed demo for Unawake is available right now until the end of Scream Fest on November 1st. 

We added not only a few Halloween surprises but took the community feedback on board that we received with our last demo during the most recent Steam Next Fest. 

We tweaked, added, and enhanced a plethora of elements (most of them suggested by the thousands of players who checked out the last demo, thank you to all!!) to make sure that your gameplay experience is better than ever – no trick-or-treating needed. 

So, what are you waiting for? 

Hop on to the Unawake main page, download the new demo and tempt your fate while trying to defend the demonic horde. 

Please feel free to leave us your feedback and suggestions here on our social media channels. 

Have fun and Happy Halloween!!!

notes.title: Unawake @ THE MIX Showcase Event
notes.content:
Hello Unawakened!

After a very successful showing at gamescom we are pleased to announce that Unawake, the First-Person-ARPG from RealityArts Studio has been part of the MIX Showcase with a new gameplay video. Presenting the relentless fights against a wide variety of enemies, utilizing various weapons and devastating special attacks not yet shown, is only the beginning, though. In the coming weeks and months we will show you more in-depth gameplay about all the other aspects of this highly anticipated mix of in-your-face combat and dynamics of First-Person-Action and the customization, loot and questing that you expect from a deep action rpg. 

So stay tuned and enjoy the latest gameplay footage from Unawake!

notes.title: Unawake – Demon Repertoire
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41046689/352cb73b20a61e27926047ac86a47d440029a7b9.png[/img]

Defenders of hope, 

Unawake is currently improving its development focus on animation, combat, and designs. Therefore, we wanted to show you some new designs of an enemy type you'll possibly face during your epic journey throughout the unknown places of Unawake.

Immerse yourself in a visceral experience where every move counts, as you engage in intense melee skirmishes with relentless demons hell-bent on eradicating mankind. Your skill and cunning will be put to the test as you unleash punishment or absolution upon your adversaries. The fate of humanity rests in your hands!

Unawake sets a new standard for enemy design and animation, with a mind-boggling array of terrifying foes that will push you to your limits. Prepare to confront unimaginable horrors as you navigate through an apocalyptic landscape, where danger lurks around every corner. Only the bravest and most resourceful will survive.

notes.title: Unawake - Arm yourself!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41046689/31943a0cfa45defe2d74c7c8e7e864fad6e046ad.png[/img]

What's your pick?

[b]Scimitar[/b]
An elegant weapon used by mounted swordsmen, as it extends the natural movement of the arm, especially during a gallop. But the curved blade can also be wielded well on the ground.

[i]With a curve like the crescent moon,
The scimitar glimmers in the light of noon,
Its edge as sharp as a serpent's tooth,
A deadly beauty, a warrior's truth.[/i]

[b]Battle axe[/b]
A one-handed battle axe is the perfect mix of a bludgeoning and cutting weapon. It causes nasty wounds but is harder to wield than other bludgeoning weapons or swords, but its effectiveness should never be underestimated.

[i]In the warrior's hand, a mighty battle axe,
Crushing armor, piercing any plate,
Its blow like lightning, swift and deadly,
Death and devastation, wherever it moves.[/i]


[b]Two-handed sword[/b]
Although it is a large sword that serves more of a representational purpose, it can be used in a fearsome manner by a strong fighter, as the blow can be delivered with much force and covers a certain radius.

[i]A two-hand sword, huge and strong,
Glides through the air like a predator's song,
Its blade cuts like a hot knife through butter,
A true master of battle and the victor.[/i]
